material: Ge, PBE (VASP 6, PAW Ge_d, ENCUT 500 eV), training database of the DeePMD potential of Fantasia et al. (2024), Materials Cloud archive 238ad-1bg44

phases.ST12: simple tetragonal, 12 atoms per cell (P4_32_12), Ge-III

records_note: One record = one archived VASP calculation (a single point or a relaxation). volume_per_atom_A3 refers to the last ionic step.
